subject: Aligning availability & meeting ownership for technical deep dive
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Henderson <alex.henderson@clearwavehealth.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + proposed owners for the technical deep dive

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: run a 60–75 minute technical deep dive focused on inference latency, model selection, and integration points for your clinical workflow.
- Success criteria (what we want to validate in the session): throughput targets for batch inference, latency SLOs at 95th pct, and a clear plan for data handling (VPC/KMS).

Proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue Dec 1, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Dec 2, 13:00–14:15
- Thu Dec 3, 09:30–10:45

Can you confirm preferred slot and who from your team will join (engineering + security/CTO if possible)? Marissa (Solutions Engineering) will lead the technical run; I’ll manage agenda/host and Neha will send calendar + materials.

Attachments: Redwood-PoC-outline.pdf (short deck) — I attached a one‑page PoC outline and a CSV with suggested attendee roles.

If you prefer Zoom over Google Meet, let me know and we’ll switch.

Thanks —
Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

From: Alex Henderson <alex.henderson@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <p.desai@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + proposed owners for the technical deep dive

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the clear recap. Wed Dec 2, 13:00–14:15 PST works best for our engineering and the CTO can join for the first 30 minutes (she needs to get back on a call after that). Attendees likely: 
- Alex Henderson (Platform Eng)
- Priya Desai (PM)
- Ravi Kumar (CTO, joining first 30m)
- Emily Tran (Security) — tentative

A couple of asks before the session:
1) Can Marissa highlight expected integration touchpoints (API payloads, auth, and KV cache behavior)?
2) Security will want a short list of logs/events we surface during PoC for compliance review.

Google Meet is fine. Please add Ravi to the invite if possible (r.kumar@clearwavehealth.com).

Appreciate it — looking forward.
Alex
Alex Henderson
Senior Platform Engineer, ClearWave Health

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + proposed owners for the technical deep dive

Great—thanks Alex. Wed Dec 2, 13:00–14:15 PST is on my calendar as tentative. 

Plan and ownership: 
- Marissa will own the technical walkthrough (integration, payloads, kv/cache behavior, quantization recommendations).
- I will own agenda, timekeeping, and the first 15 minutes of architecture-level discussion with Ravi.
- Neha will send the calendar invite with the Meet link and attach the PoC outline and a short attendees CSV.

Neha — can you please: 
1) Create a Google Meet invite for Dec 2, 13:00 PST and include r.kumar@clearwavehealth.com, alex.henderson@clearwavehealth.com, p.desai@clearwavehealth.com, and emily.tran@clearwavehealth.com (if Emily not confirmed, mark optional).
2) Attach the PoC outline and the proposed-attendees.csv to the invite.
3) Add a 10-minute pre-call note for security items to be covered by Emily.

Alex — I’ll ask Marissa to prepare a short slide (2–3) on the integration touchpoints + one slide listing the logs/events we can surface for compliance.

On Meet vs Zoom — keeping Meet for now as requested. If security requires Zoom for recording controls we can switch.

Cheers,
Logan
